links.outcome: LLM accuracy detecting spondylolisthesis on radiographs versus spine surgeon consensus
links.effect: GPT-5 sensitivity 67.5% vs GPT-4o 49.4%; accuracy 61.5% vs 55.5%; specificity 57.3% vs 59.8%; kappa 0.238 vs 0.091. Both limited compared to spine surgeons.
links.quote: With expert surgeon consensus set as ground truth, ChatGPT-5 outperformed ChatGPT-4o evidenced by higher sensitivity (67.5% vs. 49.4%) and overall accuracy (61.5% vs. 55.5%), with minor difference in specificity (57.3% vs. 59.8%).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation of multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o and a purported ChatGPT-5) for radiographic detection of lumbar spondylolisthesis compared to spine surgeon ground truth.
